subject: Retirement readiness — clarification sweep for model family phaseout
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alice Chen <alice.chen@acme.com>, Acme Platform Team <platform@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Retirement readiness — clarification sweep for model family phaseout

Hi all —

Quick intro: Acme (external) is running a pilot on our v1-chat endpoint which we plan to retire in the Sept window. Acme asked for clarity on cutover timelines and what exceptions look like. I pulled a draft timeline and a short comms note and attached both (retirement_timeline_v3.xlsx, acme_comm_draft.md).

Asks:
- Marissa: can you confirm whether Acme is eligible for a single-week extension under the customer-ops policy (they are on Dedicated but low traffic)?
- Irene: can you confirm which SDK shard will need a pin and whether the shim is ready to hand to Platform as an interim?
- Hannah: does the comms draft cover escalation language for feature parity gaps?
- Ben: if we grant an extension, what are the delta SLO/charge implications?

I'd like to consolidate answers today and send a short, single-thread update to Acme by EOD PST.

Thanks —
Dylan
Product Ops | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alice Chen <alice.chen@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Jun 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Retirement readiness — clarification sweep for model family phaseout

Dylan —

Short answers:
- Extension: Acme qualifies for a 2-week operational extension (not our standard single-week, but we can make an exception since they are in a paid pilot and have a clear cutover plan). I'll own the extension paperwork if we decide to proceed.
- Conditions: extension requires a signed mutual action plan and a confirmed rollback hatch. No SLA change beyond explicit charge for extended capacity; Ben, please confirm pricing delta.

Action: If we proceed, I suggest we add a single-row exception in the retirement tracker and notify Platform/Infra runbook owners.

-Marissa
Senior Customer Success Manager

From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@acme.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Platform Team <platform@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Jun 2028 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Retirement readiness — clarification sweep for model family phaseout

Thanks Dylan and Marissa —

Appreciate the quick review. A 2-week extension would work for our release calendar if we can lock the dates this week. Two quick technical notes from Platform:
- We rely on the v1-chat streaming behavior for a small subset of webhook consumers; need explicit confirmation that the new endpoint preserves the same chunking semantics or we'll need to add a small proxy.
- Our security team asked for the audit log retention map for the old endpoint prior to retirement (where logs will be available and for how long).

Alice
Engineering Manager, Acme Corp

---

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alice Chen <alice.chen@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Jun 2028 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Retirement readiness — clarification sweep for model family phaseout

FYI — technical notes:
- SDK shard: v1-chat is on the client-shim branch; we have a pinned shim that preserves prior streaming chunk semantics. I've uploaded a small compatibility shim to the shared drive (link in the attached timeline doc).
- Rollout path: Platform can flip routing to the new v2-chat variant once Acme toggles their client. If we do a 2-week extension, Platform will keep the v1 routing for that customer only.
- Audit logs: logs for the v1 endpoint are stored in our long-term retention bucket for 90 days post-retirement; we can provide a per-customer extraction on request.

Irene
Director, Serving Runtime

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Alice Chen <alice.chen@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Jun 2028 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Retirement readiness — clarification sweep for model family phaseout

Pricing delta (ballpark):
- Two-week extension: billable at the dedicated pilot rate + 10% operational surcharge to cover staggered routing and per-customer retention overhead. Rough estimate: +$1,200 for the extension period. I'll confirm exact numbers after I check usage curves.

Ben
Pricing Lead, Redwood Inference

Thanks team — summary and next steps:

Summary:
- We offer Acme a 2-week extension (Marissa to own paperwork).
- Irene confirms shim and routing plan; Platform will maintain v1 routing for Acme during the extension.
- Ben to confirm final extension charge (estimated +$1.2k).
- Audit logs: we can provide 90-day retention data and a per-customer extract; include link in comms.

Immediate asks (for EOD PST Monday):
- Marissa: send the extension MOU to Acme and confirm signature by Tue.
- Ben: post exact dollar delta and add the exception row to the retirement tracker.
- Irene/Hannah: update the comms draft with the exact logging link and the rollback hatch sentence; Hannah please add explicit parity language for streaming chunking.

I'll send the short, single-thread customer update once the MOU is queued.

Dylan
Product Ops | Redwood Inference
